chunks: And from him, from Abī ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام:
For the fetus of a female slave, one-tenth of her price is due.

key_terms.أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ: title of Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام

ai.seo_question: What is the compensation for the fetus of a female slave in Shia fiqh?
ai.summary: This hadith states a legal ruling concerning liability for the fetus of a female slave. It sets the compensation at one-tenth of her monetary value, reflecting a specific fiqh ruling in cases involving injury or loss.
